newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to crumple if 127.80 goes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to crumple if 127.80 goes.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will look to support at 127.80 on Monday after sliding lower at the opening as left-wing parties swept to victory in the French election on Sunday, technical analysts said.
"We're looking for a further pull-back from the Globex low," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
By 0640 GMT, the notionnel was quoted at 128.08, down 40 basis points.
He said the contract may try to push ahead initially but would find an intra-day peak at 128.14 as the first barrier.

Branigan said if the notionnel managed to push above that peak it would target further resistance at 128.20 a 38 percent retracement of the slide from Friday's Globex high at 128.86 to the low at 127.80.
A 62 percent retracement of the same move gives a target of 128.46, he said.
But if the contract broke through the 127.80 low more trouble was in store, he said. The first downside target would be around 127.44, the base for the early April rally.
Analysts at Chase also said the contract may push up initially as the nine-day RSI hit trend support.
"But it has to break trendline resistance intervening around 129.01 to open further potential to 129.52 and if above here to 129.54," they said in a research note.
"The 129.54 level forms a very important Elliott resistance and a move here identifies 127.90 as a short-term bottom," they said, noting the low on May 29.
At 0705 GMT, June Pibor were quoted at 96.30, down six basis points on the session.
Analysts said the contract would find initial resistance at 96.37, the high from Friday. A break of this session's low at 96.21 would target the low of 96.18, the low from May 26.
